inputs.checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
inputs.question: Are overhead electric poles, conductors, or guy wires shown on this site plan? If so, what is their routing relative to the proposed buildings and structures?
inputs.regionHint: along property lines and adjacent to buildings

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence and routing question (do OHE features exist, and where are they relative to buildings), which is a prerequisite discovery step before any clearance measurement can occur. This is progressive verification—the actual 7'6" clearance measurement will come later, but right now the agent needs to identify whether OHE infrastructure is present and map its general spatial relationship to structures.
